title: Hayati Pro Max Strawberry Raspberry Blueberry Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Strawberry Raspberry Blueberry blends three classic berry flavours into one smooth and juicy vape. Sweet Strawberry provides the foundation with its soft, summery sweetness, Raspberry introduces a dash of tartness, and Blueberry rounds things off with a rich, jammy depth. This trio offers a satisfying balance of sweet, sharp, and mellow berry notes in every puff. Made with nicotine salts for a smoother inhale and faster nicotine delivery, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and vape pens. Its 50VG/50PG composition delivers rich flavour with minimal vapour, making it great for all-day use. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
